children: DUBAI INTEGRATED ECONOMIC ZONES AUTHORITY (DIEZ)DOUBLES SIZE OF ORASEYA CAPITAL FUND TO AED1 BILLION - DUBAI MEDIA OFFICE
EXPANSION AIMS TO STRENGTHEN ORASEYA CAPITAL’S CAPACITY TO SUPPORT COMPANIES WITH GLOBAL GROWTH POTENTIAL - GDMO
DIEZ HAS ALSO INCREASED ORASEYA CAPITAL’S MAXIMUM INVESTMENT PER COMPANY FROM USD 3 MILLION TO USD 6 MILLION- GDMO
THE FUND IS EXPANDING ITS INVESTMENT MANDATE, SUPPORTING FOUNDERS ACROSS EVERY STAGE OF GROWTH INCLUDING BEYOND SERIES B- GDMO
